_meta.note: Plan catalog for the Prism News Exploration API (product id `prism_api`). ONE key works on both the general API (prism-news-api) and the business API (prism-business-news-api); quotas are per ACCOUNT per calendar month (UTC). Prices are DRAFT (set 2026-09-13, awaiting owner approval) and EXCLUSIVE of GST. razorpay_plan_id is null until the owner creates the Razorpay plans; until then paid tiers are granted manually.
_meta.quota_fields: requests_per_month = every authenticated call except /v1/me, /v1/status, /v1/classes*, /v1/vocabulary (free metadata). exports_per_month = full-article bodies delivered (GET /v1/articles/{id} = 1, POST /v1/export = number of articles returned). max_results = hard cap on `limit` for list endpoints. max_export_batch = cap on one POST /v1/export. rate_per_minute = sliding per-account limit. history_days = how far back `since` may go (null = whole corpus). max_keys = active API keys per account.
_meta.defaults: The owner's stated defaults: 100 headlines per query and 100 full articles per export, on every tier including free.
